measurement-environment.json.execution: Three fresh test processes, serialized after builds and static scan; each shape verifies original exact assignment outside measurement. Process isolation does not imply an otherwise idle host.

architecture-review.json.scope: One new opt-in test class in existing Unit project; uses existing pure support fixture and internal persistence codec. No project reference, runtime configuration, standalone probe or database changes.
architecture-review.json.decision: Measure width/payload allocation and time before choosing any source-read optimization. Keep all producer activation gates.
architecture-review.json.conclusion: Measured whole-launch decoding cost warrants a persistence-owned original-source/assignment projection. Define versioning, atomic capture, legacy compatibility, corruption refusal and integrity semantics before production edits.

discovery-review.json.classification: Opt-in LongRunning pure synchronous codec measurements; not a database or sustained-load benchmark.

final-resource-reconciliation.json.outcome: All five pure codec scaling shapes pass in each of three fresh processes. This qualifies baseline cost, not production capacity. No new database or host fixture was used. Historical cleanup denials remain unchanged.

production-bridge.json.meaning: Measure unchanged production codec; only opt-in Unit measurement and maintained documentation added.

data.interpretation: Whole-launch read scales materially in bytes, allocation and CPU. A 1024-step observation allocates about31MB. Design a narrow immutable original-source/assignment persistence record; hashing alone cannot remove full-graph decode. Timing is exploratory and excludes SQL/other source gates.
